Here is your Schengen visa form filled in for your holiday in Italy. Aliases are written exactly as they should go in. Anything I couldn't fill from what you gave me is marked NEEDS-YOU, with a note saying what's missing.

[B01] 1. Surname (Family name): SURNAME_P1
[B02] 2. Surname at birth (Former family name(s)): NEEDS-YOU
   If your family name has never changed, write SURNAME_P1 here as well. If it has changed (for example through a past marriage), write your surname at birth. I don't have it.
[B03] 3. First name(s) (Given name(s)): GIVEN_P1
   Fields 1–3 must match your passport. A Philippine passport prints the middle name in its own "Middle name" field, not under "Given names", so it isn't added here. If your passport's "Given names" line does include your middle name, write MIDDLE_P1 after GIVEN_P1, separated by a space.
[B04] Date of birth (day-month-year): DATE_P1
   The form wants day-month-year (for example 05-11-1990). If your passport prints the date another way, such as "05 NOV 1990", write it out by hand in day-month-year form.
[B05] 5. Place of birth: PLACE_P1
[B06] 6. Country of birth: NEEDS-YOU
   You didn't list your country of birth. Write it by hand.
[B07] 7. Current nationality: Filipino
   Nationality at birth, if different: leave blank if you were Filipino at birth. If not, NEEDS-YOU.
   Other nationalities: leave blank if you have none. If you have any, NEEDS-YOU.
[B08] 8. Sex: [x] Female
[B09] 9. Civil status: [x] Single
[B10] 10. Parental authority / legal guardian: Not applicable (adult applicant)
[B11] 11. National identity number, where applicable: leave blank
   "Where applicable" usually means a national ID number is optional. If your visa centre asks for your Philippine national ID (PhilSys) number, that's NEEDS-YOU: write it on the form yourself, not in this chat.
[B12] 12. Type of travel document: [x] Ordinary passport
   This assumes your passport is a regular personal one. If it's a diplomatic, official or other special passport, tick that box instead.
[B13] 13. Number of travel document: ID_P1
[B14] 14. Date of issue: ISSUED_P1
   Day-month-year again. If your passport prints it differently, write it out by hand in that form.
[B15] 15. Valid until: 13-03-2032
[B16] 16. Issued by (country): Philippines
   This field asks for the country, so ISSUED_P1's partner AUTHORITY_P1 (the issuing office) isn't needed here.
[B17] 17. EU/EEA/CH/UK family member: Not applicable (leave all parts blank)
[B18] 18. Family relationship with an EU, EEA or CH citizen: Not applicable (leave blank)
[B19] 19. Applicant's home address and e-mail address: ADDRESS_P1   e-mail: NEEDS-YOU
   Tel.: PHONE_P1
   You didn't list an e-mail address. Write it after the address by hand.
[B20] 20. Residence in a country other than the country of current nationality: [x] Yes
   Residence permit or equivalent: Singapore Employment Pass
   No.: NEEDS-YOU (your Employment Pass number. Copy it from your pass onto the form; don't type it here)
   Valid until: NEEDS-YOU (the expiry date on your Employment Pass, day-month-year)
[B21] *21. Current occupation: Staff nurse
[B22] *22. Employer and employer's address and telephone number: NEEDS-YOU
   Write your employer's name, its address in Singapore and its phone number.
[B23] 23. Purpose(s) of the journey: [x] Tourism
[B24] 24. Additional information on purpose of stay: Holiday in Italy
[B25] 25. Member State of main destination: Italy
[B26] 26. Member State of first entry: Italy
   This is right if you land in Rome without changing planes. If your flight connects in another Schengen country (for example Germany, France or the Netherlands), that country is your first entry: write it here instead.
[B27] 27. Number of entries requested: [x] Single entry
[B28] Intended date of arrival of the first intended stay in the Schengen area: 14-05-2027
[B29] Intended date of departure from the Schengen area after the first intended stay: 28-05-2027
[B30] 28. Fingerprints collected previously for the purpose of applying for a Schengen visa: [x] No
[B31] 29. Entry permit for the final country of destination: Not applicable (leave blank)
[B32] *30. Name of hotel(s) or temporary accommodation(s): NEEDS-YOU
   No one is inviting you, so give the hotel(s) or other places you'll stay in Italy. If you have more than one booking, list each of them.
[B33] Address and e-mail address of hotel(s)/temporary accommodation(s): NEEDS-YOU
   Telephone No.: NEEDS-YOU
   Copy these from your booking confirmations.
[B34] *31. Name and address of inviting company/organisation: Not applicable (leave blank)
[B35] Contact person in company/organisation: Not applicable (leave blank)
[B36] *32. Cost of travelling and living during the applicant's stay is covered:
   [x] by the applicant himself/herself
   Means of support: NEEDS-YOU
   Tick whatever applies to you: Cash, Traveller's cheques, Credit card, Pre-paid accommodation, Pre-paid transport, or Other. If your hotels and flights are already paid, tick Pre-paid accommodation and Pre-paid transport. If you'll pay as you go by card, tick Credit card.
   Leave the "by a sponsor" part empty.
[B37] 33. Person filling in the application form, if different from the applicant: leave blank (you're filling it in yourself)
[B38] Address, e-mail and telephone of that person: leave blank
[B39] Place and date: NEEDS-YOU
   Write the city where you sign (likely Singapore) and the date you sign, day-month-year.
[B40] Signature of applicant: sign by hand
   Signature of parental authority/legal guardian: leave blank

A few things to know:
- Because you live in Singapore, you'll normally apply through Italy's visa service in Singapore. They usually ask you to bring your Employment Pass with the form.
- The multiple-entry declaration above the signature doesn't apply to you, because you're asking for a single entry. Your visa centre will still want travel medical insurance for this trip.
- None of the boxes marked * need special handling, because you aren't applying as the family member of an EU/EEA/Swiss/UK citizen. Fill them in as shown above.
